answer: No. Git sync is primarily a backup mechanism and should not be considered for any type of collaboration; for collaboration, use a shared Server space.

Memory for: Is the Git remote sync for a managed space meant for working together with other people?
[1] Guide/Git Sync.md (Syncing with a remote)
  Syncing with a remote: A managed space can automatically fetch, merge, and push its Git repository. This is primarily a **backup mechanism**, it should not be considered for any type of collaboration.
  #guide / Use Git sync to keep a managed space’s revision repository connected to a Git remote. It fetches, merges and pushes committed history. For access from a phone or another Desktop installation, start with [[Guide/Devices and Publishing]] instead. / You need permission to manage the space’s repository connection and credentials for the destination. Use a disposable repository when trying this workflow. Enabling sync shares existing committed history as well as new changes.
[2] Revisions.md (Browsing history)
  Syncing with a remote: A managed space can fetch, merge and push its revision repository. Follow [[Guide/Git Sync]] for setup, timing and recovery. This is primarily for history and backup. Use a shared Server space for collaboration.
[3] Git.md (Git)
  Git is a [free and open source version control system](https://git-scm.com/) originally developed by Linus Torvalds (of Linux fame) and the de-facto standard in the industry. / SilverBullet uses Git for [[Revisions]]. Managed spaces can optionally fetch, merge and push to a remote through [[Guide/Git Sync]]. For access from another device, compare the alternatives in [[Guide/Devices and Publishing]].
[4] Architecture/Server.md (Server services)
  Server services: * [[Search]] maintains a server-side full-text index and, when configured, a semantic index. / * [[Revisions]] maintains or reads Git history and can synchronize a managed repository with a remote. / * The [[Runtime API]] can run space operations through a managed headless client when configured and authorized. / * Multi-space deployments manage accounts, space membership and administration through the [[Dashboard]].
[5] Install/Server Modes.md (Single-space mode)
  Multi-space mode: The default mode supports multiple spaces, local or SSO accounts, public access settings, per-member read/write roles and managed [[Revisions]] with optional Git sync. Manage these through the [[Dashboard]]. A single space with one account is also a valid configuration.
[6] CHANGELOG.md (CHANGELOG)
  2.12.0: * Git sync connections can target a chosen remote branch, including when it differs from the space’s local branch. The connection overview shows both branches, and unrelated-history errors offer a recovery action to check and combine both histories. Automatic commits during the connection check no longer invalidate it, and a checked merge tolerates new commits on either side before its first sync. / * Fix: rendered Markdown preserves application links such as `message:` and custom protocols, including URLs without `//`. / * Fix: text you type right after another user’s newly added line (for example a comment at the end of a task they just wrote)  ...
